claims.reason: Both arms independently reconstructed the exact frozen state identity at score 66,752 after 13 moves, with the ten-node route live and legal.
Two disposable WAIT_ONE replays byte-matched and reproduced the known 3,072 then 56,320 sequence with target crossing on move 15.
The public validator rejected a WAIT_ONE action relabeled CASH_NOW specifically for first-action/arm mismatch.
Both arms started with target 126,000, move 13 of 24, identical state and RNG prefix, and used the same target-stop classifier and unchanged champion after the first action.
WAIT_ONE stopped at its first target crossing on move 15 after exactly two actions.
The public trace validator rejected an appended move after the known target crossing.
Qualification retained a complete disposable artifact across a planted interpretation failure, and the reportable pair was persisted before disposition evaluation.
The vendored closeout verifier passed the disposable admission path and the reportable recomputation byte-matches the retained raw artifact.
WAIT_ONE scored 3,072 then 56,320 and first crossed the target on move 15, two moves after the common state, at score 126,144.
CASH_NOW scored 56,320 then the unchanged champion scored 10,240 and first crossed the target on move 15, two moves after the common state, at score 133,312.
Both arms won in two moves from the common state, so cash-now minus wait-one target cost is exactly zero and the registered disposition is TARGET_COST_TIE.

deviations: Before the successful qualification receipt, one qualification invocation stopped at the external closeout-identity check because the caller supplied an incorrect SHA-256. It produced no qualification, raw, or recomputation artifact, did not execute CASH_NOW, and consumed the first of the two allowed qualification attempts. The second invocation used the measured committed-file hash and passed.
